content:
watchOS 27 is the next major system update for Apple Watch, bringing multiple new features as well as two brand new apps to your watch.

#1：Siri app

Siri will undergo a major AI revamp in watchOS 27, part of which is the brand new Siri app.

The Siri app will support iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro, and Apple Watch.

watchOS 27 can still activate Siri via the Digital Crown, but this app is another place to start a conversation. More importantly, the app also lets you browse your past conversation history.

The new Siri AI will feel more like a real person than before, and will record past queries across all your devices. So the Siri app in watchOS 27 will not only show conversations on your Apple Watch, but also on your iPhone, Mac, and other devices.

For the full list of Apple Watch models supporting Siri AI, click here.

#2：Find My app

In addition to the new features the Find My app is getting in iOS 27, Apple is also rethinking the Find My experience on watchOS this year.

In the current version of watchOS 26, Find My is split into three separate apps: Find Devices, Find Items, and Find People.

But in watchOS 27, Apple is integrating all the find features into one new, unified Find My app.

Find My on Apple Watch offers all the functionality of the old three apps, but the experience is more streamlined, letting you easily find anything or anyone in a map-first interface.

You can switch between finding different items via the menu in the top left corner, otherwise the interface is consistent.
